reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior secured loan of up to USD 35m (the "EBRD Loan") equivalent in UAH (or EUR / USD) to Stolitsa Group LLC (the "Borrower"), the main Ukrainian operating entity of Stolitsa Group (the "Group"), a leading residential developer in Kyiv. The EBRD loan comprises (i) financing the development of a phase of the Varshavsky residential project in Kyiv, Ukraine (the "Project"), and (ii) financing of future phases of the Varshavsky residential project and/or other residential projects developed by the Group. The Project is expected to benefit from a first-loss risk cover provided by the European Union under the Ukraine Investment Framework Guarantee Agreement "Municipal, Infrastructure and Industrial Resilience Guarantee Programme Plus". The Project will support delivery of a phase of Varshavsky, a large master-planned residential district in Kyiv, by providing local-currency financing with a bullet repayment structure to complete five residential buildings and bring units to market without excessive reliance on pre-sales.
